commands.command: gitleaks git --redact=100 --log-level=error --report-format=json <Core and Workbench inherited source histories>
commands.summary: Three private-key-rule marker-only false positives per inherited history; all redacted and reviewed. No actual key content identified in the reports.

commands.command: gitleaks git/dir --redact=100 --log-level=error --report-format=json <final Core and Workbench candidates>
commands.summary: Final Core history/tree: three documented synthetic marker false positives each. Final Workbench history/tree: zero findings. Reports use 100 percent redaction.

commands.summary: Test could not access org.freedesktop.secrets; the test then aborted in its cleanup guard after deletion retries against the unavailable service. Not a pass; no credential could be written.

commands.command: cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked; cargo tree --workspace --locked; inspect Cargo.lock
commands.summary: All eight direct Core crates resolve from one HTTPS URL and exact revision e15fbcfa4a29e1e6df7339bfed56c15c19185f9a; eight lock source entries agree. The test invocation used a command-scoped rewrite to the local bare Core candidate, so public clean-clone reachability remains unproven.

commands.command: Regenerate Workbench publication provenance from the committed Git index and verify each listed Git blob SHA-256
commands.summary: Corrected the candidate to 206 payload paths/207 tracked files; zero missing paths, extras, or blob-hash mismatches. Six tracked Tauri schemas are included.

commands.summary: Removed generated Rust targets, node_modules, dist, and the temporary WSL target. The final source candidates are clean and contain no build output.
